Florida Primaries See Wins for Democrats and Republicans, With Some Upsets

Florida held its primary elections on Tuesday, with results showing wins for both Democratic and Republican candidates across various races. In a notable outcome, Angie Nixon, a Democratic Senate candidate, secured a victory. Republican Cory Mills lost his primary race for the House of Representatives, despite facing an inquiry. Other Republican winners included Byron Donalds and David Jolly. The primaries are set to shape the upcoming general elections.
